code:
-- Oracle: this stores NULL, not an empty string
INSERT INTO customers (customer_name, notes)
VALUES ('Acme Corp', '');

-- WHERE notes = '' silently matches nothing on Oracle
-- Use: WHERE notes IS NULL
caption: Oracle has no true empty string for VARCHAR2 -- it's NULL at storage.
STRICT_TRANS_TABLES is default since 5.7, but older installs can still be loose.

eyebrow: Pitfall 3 -- quoted identifiers fold case differently
code:
-- Oracle/PostgreSQL fold unquoted identifiers automatically
CREATE TABLE Customers (CustomerName VARCHAR2(100));
-- stored as CUSTOMERS / CUSTOMERNAME (Oracle, uppercase)

-- Quoted "CustomerName" must match that exact case FOREVER
caption: T-SQL and MySQL don't fold case this way by default -- Lesson 15's material.
